body.statement: Example 8 and Figure 5(b) of Foygel, Draisma, and Drton exhibit an acyclic five-vertex linear structural equation model whose directed support consists of five arrows and contains a rooted spanning arborescence, and whose generic covariance parametrization has degree three. Equivalently, its source function field is a degree-three extension of its covariance function field.

source.locator: Example 8, Figure 5(b), and the degree computation in Section 7
source.verbatim_statement: Generically, the fibers of this graph have cardinality of either one or three. The graphs in Figure 5(a), (b) and (d) have degree of identifiability 2, 3 and 10, respectively.
